Interface IUnitOfWork

Namespace
Snipster.Library.UOW
Assembly
Snipster.Library.dll

Defines the contract for the Unit of Work pattern, which coordinates changes across multiple repositories and manages database transactions.

Warning: Do not implement this interface yourself. It uses the default Snipster.Library.Repository.IGenericRepository`1 provided by this package. Use the provided implementation from the package instead.

Note: You may implement your own Snipster.Library.Repository.IGenericRepository`1 if you want custom repository behavior. The Snipster.Library.UOW.UnitOfWork can work with your custom repository implementation as long as it implements Snipster.Library.Repository.IGenericRepository`1.

public interface IUnitOfWork : IDisposable
